learningGoals: Identify basic 2D and 3D shapes in daily life. 🧊
Differentiate between objects that roll and objects that slide. ⚽
Create new shapes by combining basic ones. 🧩
teachingTips: Go on a 'shape hunt' around the house to find circles, squares, and rectangles. 🔍
Test different objects on a ramp to see if they roll (like a ball) or slide (like a book). 📚
Talk about the shapes of food items, like round rotis or triangular sandwiches. 🥪
Point out corners and edges on furniture to help them understand shape properties. 🪑

funActivities.title: Shape Detective 🕵️‍♀️
funActivities.description: Ask your child to find 3 round objects and 3 square objects in the kitchen within 2 minutes.

funActivities.title: Roll or Slide Ramp 🏎️
funActivities.description: Build a small ramp with a wooden board or books and test toys to see which ones roll and which slide.

funActivities.title: Matchstick Shapes 🥢
funActivities.description: Use matchsticks or toothpicks to build 2D shapes like squares, rectangles, and triangles on a table.
